Using the game

You may play as a guest or create an account. Provide accurate account information, protect your password and use a name you are entitled to use. Do not cheat, impersonate others, attack the service or interfere with other players. Server-confirmed actions and results determine online matches. Disconnected seats may be controlled automatically; an existing account attribution cannot be removed or transferred. Guest seats may bind an account by signing in during play.

Statistics and membership

Gameplay is unlimited. All signed-in accounts record every eligible completed match, including negative scores. Membership provides optional cosmetics and has no scoring advantage. Completed guest matches cannot be claimed after the game ends. See membership pricing and support for current availability, renewal, cancellation and refund information.

When enabled, recurring membership is USD $9/month or $59/year, plus applicable taxes displayed by checkout. It renews until canceled. Cancellation stops future renewals; paid access lasts to the end of the current period unless refunded or revoked. Payments are processed by Creem as merchant of record. Its checkout and buyer terms also apply. Test transactions do not take real funds or grant real paid benefits.

The service is evolving and may be interrupted for maintenance or faults. Do not rely on permanent availability or unchanged leaderboard data. Contact support about refunds, cancellation or account deletion. Material changes to pricing or membership conditions will be disclosed before they apply. Do not continue a purchase if the checkout terms differ from your expectations.
